title: Marketplace Orders Return Deductions: Fees, Restocking and Late Returns
content:
**Rule.** On Marketplace Orders, the return shipping fee is the option's remorse return shipping fee, withheld once per return. The restocking fee is the restocking rate for the received condition times the item price of the returned units: the opened rate for an item received opened but resellable, the used-or-incomplete rate for an item received used or incomplete or damaged by the buyer, and nothing for an unopened item. When the first carrier scan falls after the ship-by deadline (the return request date plus the option's return ship-by days) but within the late grace days after it, the late-return deduction rate times the item price of the returned units is also withheld; a first scan after the grace period, or after the deadline where there is no grace, means the return is rejected and no item refund is booked. A received condition of wrong item returned means no item refund is booked. Deductions never exceed the item price of the returned units, and every amount is rounded with the option's refund rounding.

**Retired clause.** The former clause "Deductions apply only to the item component of a return refund and only when the return reason is not a seller-fault reason." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for deductions.

## Restocking by received condition

| Received condition | Restocking rate applied to the item price of the returned units |
|---|---|
| unopened | none |
| opened but resellable | the option's opened rate |
| used or incomplete | the option's used-or-incomplete rate |
| damaged by the buyer | the option's used-or-incomplete rate |
| wrong item returned | no item refund is booked |

## First carrier scan against the ship-by deadline

| First scan | Effect |
|---|---|
| on or before the ship-by deadline | no late-return deduction |
| after the deadline, within the late grace days after it | the late-return deduction rate times the item price of the returned units is withheld |
| after the grace period, or after the deadline where the option has no grace | the return is rejected; no item refund is booked |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical return of 2 units at USD 60.00 on an option with a 15% opened rate, a USD 7.99 return shipping fee, 14 ship-by days, 15 grace days and a 20% late-return rate is requested on 1 June; its ship-by deadline is 15 June. The item arrives opened but resellable, first-scanned on 18 June.

1. Item price of the returned units: 2 times 60.00, that is USD 120.00.
2. Restocking fee: 15% of 120.00, that is USD 18.00.
3. Return shipping fee: USD 7.99, once for the return.
4. Late-return deduction: the scan is after 15 June and within the grace, so 20% of 120.00, that is USD 24.00.
5. Deductions total USD 49.99, which does not exceed USD 120.00.

Had the first scan come on 2 July, after the grace period that ends 30 June, the return would be rejected and no item refund booked.

superseded_clauses: Deductions apply only to the item component of a return refund and only when the return reason is not a seller-fault reason.
